days.heading: Chania old town and town beaches
days.daycost: Est. $160-$280 - beach snacks, parking/taxi, casual dinner
days.note: Do not rush to the far west on the first full Crete day. After four hiking days and two flight days, this easy 73-degree swim day is what makes the whole two-island structure feel worth it.

spots.name: Chania old town + Nea Chora / Agii Apostoli
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · ChaniaIG · Nea ChoraIG · Agii ApostoliFlickr

images.alt: The dramatic turquoise fjord-cove of Seitan Limania between steep cliffs
Aerial straight down the narrow Seitan Limania inlet to the turquoise water
A visitor on the pebble beach facing the narrow Seitan Limania cove

spots.cost: Harbor wandering and town beaches are free. Add $60-$150 family for chairs, gelato, simple dinner, and taxis/parking depending where you stay.
spots.climate: June: Chania averages around 84 F highs / 66 F lows; sea water around 73 F is the payoff the whole route is built around.
spots.saveHtml: Save Make arrival and recovery days mostly free: harbor, beach, bakery breakfast, and a simple pizza/gyro dinner.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Use one harbor dinner or sunset boat if the flight day went smoothly; skip if the family just needs sleep.
spots.restoHtml:
• Oregano's — Agii Apostoli wood-fired pizza, fresh pasta, grilled meats, and Greek basics
  • Goody's Burger House — burgers, chicken burgers, fries, and junior menu fallback
  • Lithos Restaurant — beef burger with fries, grilled chicken, chicken/pork gyros, and skewers
spots.altboxHtml:
• Marathi or Stavros beach ↩ — easier, calmer beach backup if west-coast winds make the big beaches rough.
  • Marathi Beach ↗ — calmer Akrotiri swim day when wind makes Balos or Elafonissi rough.
  • Falasarna sunset ↗ — self-drive big beach with a sunset payoff if a boat day is not the mood.

days.heading: Balos boat from Kissamos

facts.label: Wind swap
facts.valueHtml: Trade days with Elafonissi if needed

days.note: With Chania squeezed to five nights there is no dedicated flex day anymore - Balos and Elafonissi are deliberately back-to-back so they can swap by wind forecast. Keep it public-boat/simple unless the budget is pricing unusually low.

spots.name: Balos Lagoon by Kissamos boat
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Balos LagoonFlickr

images.alt: Balos Lagoon's white sandbar curving to Gramvousa from the hilltop overlook
Shallow turquoise water over the white sandbar at Balos Lagoon
Traditional excursion boat on turquoise water en route to Balos

spots.cost: Current 2026 pre-Jul-15 Gramvousa/Balos boat pricing: EUR 40 ages 13+, EUR 24 ages 3-12, plus EUR 1 municipal fee for passengers over 13. Family baseline about EUR 147 before meals.
spots.climate: Mid-June: hot, bright, and exposed. Water should be comfortable enough for real swimming, but shade and wind are the deciding factors.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use the public Kissamos boat and bring snacks/water. Driving the rough Balos road adds car-risk and a steep walk back up.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private boat only if the total trip is pricing near the low end; it can be wonderful, but it is the easiest budget blowout.
spots.restoHtml:
• Oregano's — Agii Apostoli wood-fired pizza, fresh pasta, grilled meats, and Greek basics
  • Goody's Burger House — burgers, chicken burgers, fries, and junior menu fallback
  • Lithos Restaurant — beef burger with fries, grilled chicken, chicken/pork gyros, and skewers
spots.altboxHtml:
• Falasarna sunset beach ↩ — simpler self-drive beach day if wind, boat timing, or budget makes Balos unattractive.
  • Agii Apostoli beaches ↗ — short-drive coves near Chania with easier food and less commitment.
  • Marathi Beach ↗ — calmer Akrotiri swim day when west-coast wind is the issue.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Official Balos boat price sourceBalos by car caution source

days.heading: Elafonissi lagoon or Falasarna sunset
days.daycost: Est. $160-$320 - fuel, parking, loungers/meals if used
days.note: Pick by wind and energy: Elafonissi is the shallow pink-sand lagoon day; Falasarna is the simpler big-beach/sunset day. If Balos got blown out on the prior boat outing, this is its replacement slot and the lagoon becomes the backup.

spots.name: Elafonissi Lagoon or Falasarna sunset
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · ElafonissiIG · FalasarnaFlickr

images.alt: Elafonissi's pink sand and turquoise lagoon framed by black volcanic rock
Pink sand curving into the shallow turquoise lagoon at Elafonissi
Aerial of Elafonissi's pink-white sandbars and turquoise shallows

spots.cost: Beach entry is free. Elafonissi close parking currently advertises EUR 5/day; Falasarna loungers/umbrellas often vary by row/operator, so budget $60-$180 family if using chairs and meals.
spots.climate: Mid-June: shallow lagoon water feels warmer than open beaches. Wind is the variable; keep Falasarna as the sunset backup.
spots.saveHtml: Save Bring towels, water shoes, and snacks; use paid chairs only if you are staying several hours.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Pay for a well-located sunbed set and a low-effort beach lunch when heat is high.
spots.restoHtml:
• Oregano's — Agii Apostoli wood-fired pizza, fresh pasta, grilled meats, and Greek basics
  • Goody's Burger House — burgers, chicken burgers, fries, and junior menu fallback
  • Lithos Restaurant — beef burger with fries, grilled chicken, chicken/pork gyros, and skewers
spots.altboxHtml:
• Agii Apostoli beaches ↩ — short-drive fallback near Chania if the family is done with long road days.
  • Limnoupolis Water Park ↗ — straight kid-win backup for heat, wind, or hike fatigue.
  • Marathi Beach ↗ — calmer Akrotiri swim day when wind makes Balos or Elafonissi rough.

days.heading: Imbros Gorge and south-coast swim
days.daycost: Est. $170-$330 - entrance, return ride/taxi, meals, fuel

facts.label: Hike
facts.valueHtml: 8km Imbros village -> Komitades; easier than Samaria

days.note: Imbros stays the family-accessible gorge: shorter, shadier, no ferry, and a good gut-check before deciding whether Samaria is a full descent or lazy-way outing on a later hiking day.

spots.name: Imbros Gorge + south-coast swim
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · ImbrosFlickr

images.alt: A hiker spanning the towering walls at the narrowest point of Imbros Gorge
Golden light in the tight rock passage of Imbros Gorge
Sheer canyon walls and greenery along the Imbros Gorge trail

spots.cost: Entrance is typically EUR 3-EUR 5 pp cash. If self-driving, start at Imbros village and arrange a Komitades-to-Imbros return taxi/minibus before you begin; shared rides are commonly about EUR 8 pp, or roughly EUR 25-35 for a small private taxi.
spots.climate: 8 km, 2.5-4 hrs: easier and shorter than Samaria, mostly downhill from Imbros village to Komitades with shade in the narrows. Still rocky underfoot, with no services inside the gorge; start early and carry water.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use the self-drive pattern: park at Imbros, walk down to Komitades, then take the pre-arranged local taxi/minibus back to the car. No ferry is required, which is why this is the gentler family gorge.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Book a Chania transfer tour if you do not want to manage the car-return logistics; the hike itself stays the same but the day becomes simpler.
spots.restoHtml:
• Oregano's — Agii Apostoli wood-fired pizza, fresh pasta, grilled meats, and Greek basics
  • Goody's Burger House — burgers, chicken burgers, fries, and junior menu fallback
  • Lithos Restaurant — beef burger with fries, grilled chicken, chicken/pork gyros, and skewers
spots.altboxHtml:
• Samaria Gorge ↩ — the epic 16 km version if everyone is trail-tested and the heat forecast cooperates.
  • Frangokastello Beach ↗ — south-coast swim and castle views after the gorge or as a low-effort swap.
  • Limnoupolis Water Park ↗ — straight kid-win backup for heat, wind, or hike fatigue.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Imbros access + return taxi details ↗Imbros practical guide ↗

days.heading: Samaria Gorge: full White Mountains descent

facts.label: Logistics
facts.valueHtml: Early KTEL from Chania; ANENDYK ferry out; return bus from Sougia/Sfakia

days.note: Samaria supplies a full mountain-to-sea day when the family wants the leg’s biggest hike. For the 8-year-old, the complete descent is conditional; the shorter route from Agia Roumeli toward the Iron Gates is the kid-friendlier substitute.

spots.name: Samaria Gorge — full Lefka Ori descent
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Samaria GorgeIG · Lefka OriFlickr

images.alt: The footbridge at the Iron Gates where Samaria Gorge pinches between towering walls
Tiny hikers dwarfed by the narrowest squeeze of the Samaria Gorge walls
The cypress-lined switchback descent into Samaria Gorge from Xyloskalo

spots.cost: Plan roughly EUR 65-EUR 100 family for park entry, KTEL buses, and ANENDYK ferry tickets if self-guided; guided transfers commonly price higher but simplify the bus/ferry chain. Bring cash for small add-ons in Agia Roumeli.
spots.climate: Mountain start, hot finish: Xyloskalo/Omalos starts around 1,200-1,250 m, but the lower gorge and Agia Roumeli can feel full-summer hot by afternoon. Start on the first practical Chania bus, carry 2L+ water per adult, hats, snacks, and real shoes.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use public logistics if everyone is comfortable with the sequence: early KTEL Chania -> Xyloskalo/Omalos, hike to Agia Roumeli, ANENDYK ferry to Sougia or Chora Sfakion, then the waiting KTEL bus back to Chania.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Book a guided transfer day if you want one throat to choke for ferry timing, bus seats, and pickup. It does not make the 16 km easier; it only removes logistics friction.
spots.restoHtml:
• Xyloskalo Restaurant — trailhead breakfast/coffee with the gorge view before the descent.
  • Faragi, Agia Roumeli — post-hike taverna; fries, grilled meat, simple pasta/rice-style kid orders.
  • Goody's Burger House Chania — late, plain burger/fries fallback after the long return.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Lazy way from Agia Roumeli ↩ — ferry to Agia Roumeli, walk about an hour / ~2 km up to the Iron Gates, then return to the beach and ferry. This is the kid-friendly Samaria version if the full descent is too much.
  • Agia Roumeli beach ↗ — if you finish early, swim/eat before the 17:30 ferry window.
  • Limnoupolis Water Park ↗ — the no-guilt bailout if heat, legs, or ferry logistics are wrong.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Official Samaria crossing logistics ↗KTEL Chania bus/ferry return plan ↗ANENDYK ferry + lazy-way note ↗

days.heading: Lefka Ori / Omalos high-country → Rethymno
days.daycost: Est. $170-$320 - fuel, plateau lunch, Fortezza option

facts.label: Evening
facts.valueHtml: Old town + Fortezza at golden hour

days.note: Use the transfer as the White Mountains half-day: Omalos plateau, Xyloskalo, and a short Kallergi approach if legs allow, then Rethymno for dinner. If everyone is cooked after Samaria, make it viewpoint-and-lunch only.

spots.name: Lefka Ori / Omalos plateau high-country
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Lefka OriIG · Omalos CreteFlickr

images.alt: The bare limestone peaks and ridgelines of the Lefka Ori White Mountains
The green Omalos plateau ringed by rocky hills under a deep-blue sky
Pine-forested slopes and bare summits framing a Lefka Ori gorge

spots.cost: Viewpoints and the plateau drive are free. Budget fuel/parking plus lunch in Omalos; guided high-country half-days are optional, not required. Do not drive the 5 km dirt road to Kallergi unless the car/rental terms and road condition make that reasonable.
spots.climate: 1,040-1,680 m high country: cooler and windier than Chania, with fast cloud movement. This is the above-the-clouds / White Mountains register without committing the family to another all-day descent.
spots.saveHtml: Save Make the family version simple: Chania -> Omalos plateau -> Xyloskalo viewpoint -> short Kallergi approach walk -> lunch -> Rethymno. The full refuge hike is optional.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Hire a local mountain guide only if you want to push beyond the viewpoint/refuge approach; weather, wayfinding, and rental-car limits matter more in the Lefka Ori than on beach roads.
spots.restoHtml:
• Neos Omalos Hotel Restaurant — breakfast from 06:45 and lunch/dinner service; easy pre/post-hike food.
  • Xyloskalo Restaurant — right above the Samaria entrance, good for coffee, fries, grilled basics, and the view.
  • Exari, Omalos — traditional hotel/taverna on the plateau; simple local lunch before driving east.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Kallergi Refuge approach ↩ — moderate 1.5-hour hike from Xyloskalo if the family wants the real high-country hit.
  • Xyloskalo viewpoint only ↗ — 20-minute version when the legs are done after Samaria/Imbros.
  • Lake Kournas ↗ — lowland backup on the way to Rethymno if the plateau is socked in.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Omalos plateau overview ↗Kallergi Refuge access ↗Kallergi hiking logistics ↗

spots.name: Rethymno old town + Fortezza + beach
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · RethymnoIG · FortezzaFlickr

images.alt: Rethymno old town, harbour and beach under a pink dusk sky from above
Rethymno's Venetian harbour illuminated at blue hour
The Venetian Fortezza fortress walls above the deep-blue sea at Rethymno

spots.cost: Old town and beach are free. Fortezza current reported summer price is about EUR 4 adult, so plan roughly $15-$25 family depending child pricing and small museums.
spots.climate: Jun 19-20: Rethymno sea is around 73-75 F in current June averages. Evenings are the sweet spot for old town.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use Rethymno as a mostly free recovery base: beach, old town lanes, Fortezza views, bakeries, and apartment meals.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Pay for one polished old-town dinner on the final night - the last warm evening of the trip.
spots.restoHtml:
• Casa di Haris — pizza, fries, burgers, club sandwiches, and pasta in the old town
  • Veneto Restaurant — tomato linguini, Bolognese, chicken nuggets with fries, and pinsa Margherita
  • Kokkinos — gyros, souvlaki, grilled chicken, fries, pizza, and simple Greek plates
spots.altboxHtml:
• Arkadi Monastery + Lake Kournas ↩ — good transfer-day culture/nature stop; Arkadi admission is commonly reported around EUR 3, kids under 16 free.
  • Bali Beach ↗ — protected north-coast coves if Rethymno beach is windy.
  • Panormo Beach ↗ — small harbor village and swim stop with a calmer pace than Rethymno town.

days.heading: Preveli Palm Beach and Kourtaliotiko Gorge
days.note: The south-coast finale: palm-lined river, gorge walls, one last warm swim. Keep it practical - one gorge/water moment plus the beach, not a full expedition - and be back for the final old-town dinner.

spots.name: Preveli Palm Beach + Kourtaliotiko Gorge
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · PreveliIG · KourtaliotikoFlickr

images.alt: Preveli's palm-lined river meeting the turquoise sea at the beach mouth
The turquoise bay and palm river at Preveli from the cliffs above
A shaft of light falling onto the turquoise plunge pool in Kourtaliotiko Gorge

spots.cost: Kourtaliotiko managed access is currently reported around EUR 5 pp. Preveli beach itself is free; parking commonly runs a few euros. Family day estimate: $35-$90 before lunch.
spots.climate: June: south coast is warmer and more exposed. Bring water, shoes, and shade; the stairs and gorge surfaces matter more than the mileage.
spots.saveHtml: Save Do the gorge/Preveli combo independently by car, and skip paid tours unless water levels or access rules require a guide.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Book guided river trekking only if current rules and safety conditions make it clearly better than a self-guided viewpoint/beach day.
spots.restoHtml:
• Casa di Haris — pizza, fries, burgers, club sandwiches, and pasta in the old town
  • Veneto Restaurant — tomato linguini, Bolognese, chicken nuggets with fries, and pinsa Margherita
  • Kokkinos — gyros, souvlaki, grilled chicken, fries, pizza, and simple Greek plates
spots.altboxHtml:
• Plakias / Damnoni beach ↩ — easier beach fallback with more food and less stair commitment if Preveli logistics look hard.
  • Bali Beach ↗ — protected north-coast coves if Rethymno beach is windy.
  • Panormo Beach ↗ — small harbor village and swim stop with a calmer pace than Rethymno town.
